implementation_notes: Build it once, duplicate it once, abstract at the third. At the second occurrence the useful act is not extraction but comparison: write down what differs, because those differences are the only evidence you have.
code_sketch:
occurrences = 1 -> build directly
occurrences = 2 -> duplicate, record the differences
occurrences >= 3 -> extract the identical part, parameterise the rest
pitfalls: Extracting from the first two cases only
